featured_reviews.name: Aryan Chile
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a wonderful shopping experience at Star Bazar - Churchgate. The store is very well-organized, clean, and stocked with a wide variety of products ranging from groceries and daily essentials to household items and snacks. Everything was arranged properly, making shopping very convenient and hassle-free.

What stood out the most was the quality of service. The staff members were polite, helpful, and always ready to assist whenever needed. Billing was smooth and quick even during busy hours, which made the overall experience even better. The store also offers great discounts and deals on many products, making it a good place for regular shopping.

The freshness of fruits, vegetables, and bakery items was impressive, and the product variety gives you plenty of options to choose from. The atmosphere inside the store feels comfortable and spacious, making it easy to shop peacefully without feeling crowded.

The location is also very convenient, especially for people around Churchgate and nearby areas. Overall, a reliable and excellent supermarket for everyday shopping needs. Definitely deserving of 5 stars for maintaining quality, service, and customer satisfaction consistently.

featured_reviews.name: Jyotshna Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had an exceptional experience at a supermarket that left me thoroughly impressed. From the moment I walked in, the store was well-organized, with every section clearly marked, making it easy to find all the essentials I needed. I was delighted to see a wide range of groceries, dry fruits, fresh produce, and household items — everything under one roof.

What stood out the most was the affordability of the products without compromising on quality. The prices were reasonable, with some great offers that made the shopping experience even more satisfying.

The staff were incredibly courteous and helpful, always available to guide me in locating items and answering my questions. Their friendly demeanor and quick service at checkout made the experience smooth and enjoyable.

Overall, it was refreshing to shop at a place that offers variety, quality, excellent service, and affordability — a combination that’s hard to find these days. I will definitely be visiting this supermarket again!

featured_reviews.name: Chanchal Mantri
featured_reviews.review_text:
This store is basically the unofficial survival center of students having their colleges in Churchgate area. So also, hostel students treat this place like their personal pantry. Since there's barely any alternative nearby, this place enjoys full monopoly.
You will find almost all daily essentials here, veggies, bakery products, biscuits, maggi, pasta, toiletries, snacks, soft drinks, and random new products that appear out of nowhere sometimes. Milk is a bit like a lucky draw though, usually available only in the first half of the day.

The shop is super convenient when you urgently need something and don’t want to walk all the way elsewhere. Every college student around here has probably visited this store once.
BUT. Summers here are an extreme sport. Those desert coolers here somehow make you feel so uncomfortable in scorching heat.
They are closed on Sundays, and for rest of the days open after 9 AM, and shut by around 8 PM.

Overall: great for emergency and daily needs shopping. But if you actually want better discounts and more options, Star Bazaar nearby is the smarter move.
